name: Timeline
summary: What happened, in order. An ordered list with a rail down one side and a dot at each entry, so the order is in the structure and not only in the picture.
summaryZh: 先后发生过的事。一条有序列表,一侧是竖线,每个条目一个圆点,所以顺序写在结构里,不只画在图上。

variants.name: Success
variants.note: The node of this entry takes the success colour.

variants.name: Warning
variants.note: The node of this entry takes the warning colour.

variants.name: Danger
variants.note: The node of this entry takes the danger colour.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

states.name: Reversed
states.note: The entries run the other way: the newest one is at the top.

states.name: Rail at the end
states.note: The rail stands at the end of every row and the text is beside it.

states.name: Alternating
states.note: The rows swap sides, one after the other.

states.name: Alternating, reversed
states.note: The rows swap sides the other way round, so the first one is the one with the rail at the end.

states.name: Centred
states.note: The node sits in the middle of the row rather than at the top of it.

states.name: Hollow
states.note: The node is a ring rather than a filled dot.

parts.name: Item
parts.note: One entry. It carries the tone modifier, so one timeline can mix states.

parts.name: Node
parts.note: The dot. It is drawn in CSS and carries the colour of the entry.

parts.name: Tail
parts.note: The rail between two entries. It is decoration and is hidden on the last entry.

parts.name: Wrapper
parts.note: The column beside the rail. It holds the timestamp and the text of the entry.

props.name: variant
props.description: The tone of the entry. It is written on the item, not on the timeline.
props.descriptionZh: 这一条的状态。它写在条目上,不写在整个时间线上。

props.name: timestamp
props.description: When it happened. It is a time element inside the wrapper, so the machine-readable value and the written one travel together.
props.descriptionZh: 发生的时间。它是内容区里的 time 元素,所以机器可读的值和写出来的值在一起。

props.name: reverse
props.description: Runs the entries the other way: the newest one is at the top.
props.descriptionZh: 把条目反过来排:最新的在最上面。

props.name: mode
props.description: Where the rail stands in relation to the text. The start run is the base class on its own: the rail is at the start of the row.
props.descriptionZh: 轨道和文字的相对位置。靠前就是只写基类:轨道在每行的开头。

props.name: center
props.description: Puts the node in the middle of the row rather than at the top of it.
props.descriptionZh: 把节点放在这一行的中间,而不是顶上。

props.name: hollow
props.description: Draws the node as a ring rather than a filled dot.
props.descriptionZh: 把节点画成一个圈,而不是一个实心点。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the node. The medium size is the base class on its own.
props.descriptionZh: 节点的大小。中号就是只写基类。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The entries. Each one is the caller's own element, and the tone modifier goes on the entry rather than on the list.
slots.descriptionZh: 各条条目。每一条都是使用方自己的元素,状态修饰类写在条目上,不是写在整条时间线上。

slots.name: dot
slots.description: The node. It is drawn in CSS and ships empty, and this slot takes a mark of the host's own.
slots.descriptionZh: 节点。它由 CSS 画出来,本身是空的,这个插槽放使用方自己的标记。

slots.name: wrapper
slots.description: The body of the entry: the timestamp and the text.
slots.descriptionZh: 这一条的内容:时间和文字。

a11y.notes: The timeline is an ol, so the reader is told how many entries there are and can step through them. The node and the rail carry no information the text does not already carry: mark them aria-hidden, and the entry is read as one line of text.
a11y.notesZh: 时间线是 ol,读屏会告诉读者一共几条,也能按条走。节点和竖线不带文字以外的信息:给它们加上 aria-hidden,这一条就读成一行文字。

examples.title: A timeline
examples.description: The rail is drawn by the tail and the dot by the node. The last entry has no rail below it.
examples.descriptionZh: 竖线由 tail 画出,圆点由 node 画出。最后一条下面没有竖线。
examples.markup:
1. 28 November, 09:12 Build 214 started on node A.
  2. 28 November, 14:20 Three nodes reported the same result.
  3. 28 November, 16:05 The build was marked as passing.

examples.title: Tones
examples.description: The tone is written on the entry, not on the timeline, because one timeline usually holds a success, a warning and a plain entry together.
examples.descriptionZh: 状态写在条目上,不写在时间线上,因为一条时间线里通常同时有成功、警告和普通三种条目。
examples.markup:
1. 28 November, 09:12 The certificate was renewed.
  2. 28 November, 11:40 Two devices were replaced under warranty.
  3. 28 November, 16:05 The rollback was called off by hand.

notes: The tone modifier hangs off the item rather than off the base class, so the manifest's modifier prefix is `um-timeline__item--`: one timeline usually carries a success, a warning and a plain entry at once, and a tone on the whole list could only say one thing. The rail is positioned against the item, not against the text, so it stays under the dots when the text beside it wraps.
notesZh: 状态的修饰类挂在条目上而不是基类上,所以这份清单里的修饰类前缀是 `um-timeline__item--`:一条时间线通常同时有成功、警告和普通三种条目,而整条列表只有一个色调的话就只能说一件事。竖线是相对条目定位的,不是相对文字,所以文字换行时它还停在圆点下面。
